purpose: Obtain the depth-to-proxy diagnostic breakdown before any production algorithm changes. Captured physical geometry is evaluation-only.
root_causes: Stable real post evidence reaches the map but radius2 sparse-support filtering discards most or all of it: initial static33 occupied→4 retained, thin13→3, partially visible post23→0. Their existing probabilities are saturated at0.98201379 despite repeated observations.
The first post-insertion hit contradicts accumulated FREE prior and becomes UNKNOWN; the next hit establishes occupancy. That transient does not explain disappearance after many stable updates.
The actual selected-pixel pattern repeats while camera/depth-validity geometry is unchanged; waiting longer reinforces probabilities without increasing spatial neighbor density.

Selected physical post rays are not removed by automatic robot filtering in these settled snapshots. Camera occlusion reduces the partial post observation, but does not eliminate its23 selected physical rays.
Nominal empty-scene V2 registrations are fragmented support-plane evidence: first32 and last64 are all floor-only, with no external hazards. Ground truth uses one exact contiguous floor box.

Partial-scene budget saturation is separate from support rejection: the baseline retains Occluder59cells but Post0; a confidence-only replay retains Post23 while the unchanged64 budget explicitly omits more occluder detail.

Original V2 partial reactive attempts failed during empty START setup, before actor insertion, and recorded no raw depth or measured route. Those failures establish source-availability problems, not evidence that the physical post was invisible.

confidence_retention_proposal.source_scope: RGB-D temporal occupancy only; generic/ground-truth default remains unchanged
confidence_retention_proposal.rule: Retain original eligible OCCUPIED cells with probability>=0.95 in addition to existing radius2 support.

threshold_interpretation.free_prior_qualification: A contradictory first hit may first withhold the previous FREE claim as UNKNOWN.

confidence_retention_proposal.observed_initial_threshold_sensitivity: 0.9,0.95,0.98 produce identical settled selected-object counts in all four captures.
confidence_retention_proposal.geometry_constraints: No cell-state changes, padding, unknown/free filling, mesh completion, new dense history or higher proxy budget. Each retained box remains an exact union of original occupied cells and retains its original evidence expiry.
confidence_retention_proposal.empty_counterfactual: Across all24 captured empty jobs, none of the three thresholds adds an above-plane occupied cell. They retain more repeated floor cells, still bounded by64 proxies.
confidence_retention_proposal.unresolved: The confidence rule does not compact a sparse surface or solve all64-budget omissions. Native physical response and matched source timing remain to be measured.

qualifications: All full captures add worker serialization/disk overhead and are excluded from source/control latency claims. Static is the retained compressed first capture; other three are uncompressed. Compare exact per-update evidence and probabilities, not their wall-time publication rates.
Full capture Direct has no runtime obstacle product; the original V2 adapter is replayed offline on actual captured snapshots. Physical boxes never augment the RGB-D map or runtime product.

Counts outside strict fixture AABB bins include voxel-boundary aliases of measured surfaces and are not automatically false hazards. The follow-up exact selected-endpoint audit is now recorded below and explains all initial above-plane cells.
AABB voxel counts describe partial occupied evidence, not complete object reconstruction. Missing depth, filtered rays, unknown interior and explicit budget omissions remain distinct.
The original V2 failed records remain unchanged. The four new captures are forensic baselines, not successful reactive avoidance experiments.

boundary_alias_verification.method: Compare above-plane captured OCCUPIED voxel IDs with actual selected, unmasked rays matching independent physical fixture surfaces. All initial above-plane cells are explained by those physical endpoints; strict AABB bin misses are voxel-boundary aliases.
